verdict.rationale: The vendor states NFC tap-to-authenticate for compatible Android and iOS devices, and the GitHub README describes Solo 2 as a USB+NFC passkey/WebAuthn device. A community comment independently notes Solo v2 has "stronger NFC." The "Everything in Solo 2 plus" wording suggests NFC may be limited to a specific model. Missing for 10: documentation of which mobile browsers and apps work, clarity on which SKU includes NFC, and hands-on reports of actual phone authentication.
